summary: Added a portable headless-browser smoke harness for the built app, strengthened responsive overflow safeguards, expanded automated coverage, and updated handoff docs. The remaining limitation is environmental: this sandbox has no runnable Chromium-family browser, so the new browser smoke check could not be completed here.
completed_work: Added `scripts/browserSmoke.mjs`, which builds a `file://`-based headless-browser harness for the `dist/` app, auto-runs the sample paste flow, and checks both desktop (`1280px`) and mobile (`360px`) viewports for correct rendering and horizontal overflow.
Added `test/browserSmoke.test.js` to cover the browser smoke harness helpers and `test/responsiveLayout.test.js` to lock in the key responsive CSS rules.
Hardened `src/styles.css` with shrink/wrap safeguards and explicit max-width containment for the sample and preview overflow containers.
Added `npm run test:browser` in `package.json` and documented the browser smoke workflow, prerequisites, and static-bundle verification path in `README.md`.
Updated `FINAL_OUTPUT.md` so verification evidence and remaining limits match what was actually exercised in this round.

verification.result: Passed. All 5 test files succeeded, including parser, optimizer, real `src/main.js` DOM smoke coverage, browser-smoke helper tests, and responsive layout regression tests.
Passed. `node ./scripts/build.mjs` completed and rebuilt the static `dist/` bundle.
Failed as expected in this sandbox because no Chromium-family browser binary is available. The script exited with `Chromium 계열 브라우저를 찾지 못했습니다. --browser=/path/to/browser 로 직접 지정해 주세요.`

known_gaps: Actual browser-engine execution of `npm run test:browser` is still unverified in this sandbox because no supported browser binary is installed here.

The original QA ask for concrete browser/mobile runtime evidence is only partially addressed in this environment; the repo now contains the executable harness, but QA still needs to run it on a machine with Chromium/Chrome/Edge.
Nice-to-have scope remains out of scope: role preference ordering, saved player pools, and multi-game support.
handoff_notes: For the next QA pass, run `npm run build` first, then `npm run test:browser -- --browser=/path/to/chromium` on a machine with a Chromium-family browser installed.
The browser smoke script does not require a local HTTP server; it verifies the built `dist/` bundle through a temporary `file://` harness, which avoids the sandbox's blocked local-port limitation.

If QA reports a real-browser failure, start with `scripts/browserSmoke.mjs`, `test/browserSmoke.test.js`, and `test/responsiveLayout.test.js`; those files contain the intended viewport checks and overflow assertions.
